limitations: Four contract groups and thirteen directly affected source regressions: final engine run 14.25 seconds, 17/17. SC-STRATEGY-REVIEW is a separate current manual design/planning review, not another engine check.
Ordinary simple obligations are generated in one scene; no signing, delivery, law simulation, specific record-preservation term or reciprocal two-leg producer is implemented by this task.

Controlled initial RNG and real response checks; no target obligation, prayer, dependency or continuation is injected. Succession uses the existing initial graph; status/death prerequisites are performed by the existing deadline fixture through World commands.

The fixed-successor-ineligible control uses a read-only counterfactual; real no-candidate EVENT05A and normal EVENT05B execute through Turn. This does not exhaustively test all social graph combinations.

Two failed batches retained. First aborted on deep-copying readonly archive roots in a fixture; second self-reported 17 pass but engine readonly/script errors correctly prevented acceptance. Parent independently reviewed dead-history knowledge mutation, authorized one minimal fix and targeted verification, without claiming a model-tier change.

Events keep dead parties as historical targets while granting no new knowledge to them. Actual release preserves dead knowledge and invalidates the exact dependency; actual succession grants only contract/dependency/continuation knowledge to the fixed successor.

Turn component save/restore only; full Session/CULT compatibility, natural rates, entire CIV06 anchor routes, reciprocal two-leg operations, bounded opportunity guarantees and balance remain downstream.

Windows certificate store environment ERROR remains. Final gate rejects script/readonly errors even when individual JSON assertions pass. Implementation-status documentation was updated after code freeze; gameplay/test/CSV bytes stayed frozen.
